search_placeholder: Application no., name, email or mobile
name: Name
walk_in_note: Documents can be uploaded and verified on the next screen.
edit_note: Changing the program or applicant type updates the document checklist. Items already received are kept.
file_rule: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each.
verify_original_hint: Verify after checking the original document at the counter
no_requirements_configured: No documents are configured for this program and applicant type.
conditions_placeholder: For example: submit original Form 138 before the start of classes
incomplete_requirements_hint: Some required documents are not yet verified. You can admit conditionally, or wait until the checklist is complete to accept.
decision_available_after_submission: A decision can be recorded once the application is being processed.
confirm_status_change: Change the status of this application?
final_status_note: This application has a final decision.
converted_inquiry_cannot_be_deleted: This inquiry already has an application and cannot be deleted.
authority_reference_hint: CHED permit or recognition no., or TESDA registration no.
terms_note: College applicants choose from terms marked open. TESDA applicants give a preferred schedule and are placed in a batch later.
rules_note: Each rule adds a document to the checklist of matching applications. Leave applicant type or program blank to apply to all. Changes affect new applications only.
program_not_available: The selected program is not accepting applications.
term_not_open: The selected term is not open for applications.
term_required: Please choose the term you are applying for.
consent_required: Please agree to the data privacy notice to continue.
document_types_allowed: Documents must be PDF, JPG or PNG files.
document_size_limit: Each document must be 5 MB or smaller.
remarks_required_for_rejected: Please give the reason the document is returned.
remarks_required_for_waived: Please give the reason the document is waived.
only_required_items_can_be_waived: Only required documents can be waived.
not_ready_for_decision: This application is not ready for a decision.
accept_needs_complete_requirements: All required documents must be verified or waived before accepting. Use conditional admission instead.
conditions_required: Please state the conditions of admission.
only_withdrawn_or_deferred_can_reopen: Only withdrawn or deferred applications can be reopened.
application_is_closed: This application is closed and can no longer be changed.
duplicate_application: An active application for this program and term already exists for this applicant.
apply_intro: Fill in the form below. Fields marked with * are required. You can upload documents now or later from the status page.
step_submit_text: You receive an application number right away.
step_documents_text: Upload them online or bring them to the Registrar.
step_evaluation_text: The Registrar checks your documents and eligibility.
step_decision_text: Check your status online using your application number.
already_applied_text: Use your application number and date of birth to see your status and upload missing documents.
tuition_note: Free tuition may apply to eligible students under Republic Act No. 10931. The Registrar will confirm your eligibility during enrollment.
applications_closed_text: No program is accepting online applications right now. Please check back or contact the college.
documents_intro: These are the documents for your program and applicant type. Clear photos or scans are fine for now; bring the originals when you enroll.
choose_program_first: Choose a program and applicant type to see the documents you need.
privacy_consent_apply: I agree that Tarlac Provincial College may collect and process my personal information for admission and enrollment, as described in the :link.
certify_true: I certify that the information I have given is true and complete.
lookup_intro: Enter the application number you received and your date of birth.
too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
application_not_found: We could not find an application with those details. Check the application number and date of birth.
application_received_text: Your application number is :number. Keep it to check your status and upload documents.
public_requirements_pending: Some required documents are still missing or need to be uploaded again. Upload them below or bring them to the Registrar.
public_for_evaluation: Your documents are complete. The Registrar is evaluating your application.
public_admitted: Congratulations! You are admitted. The Registrar will contact you about enrollment.
public_conditional: You are admitted on condition. Please complete the conditions below before enrollment.
public_rejected: We are unable to admit you at this time. Please contact the Registrar for details.
public_deferred: This application has been deferred. Please contact the Registrar if you wish to continue.
originals_note: Bring the originals when you enroll.
keep_this_text: You need your application number and date of birth to return to this page.
need_help_text: Contact the Registrar's Office if you have questions about your application.
matrix_help: Academic points come from the senior-high average. The office enters the admission-test points (up to 35) and the financial points (up to 30). Sector points are 15 only when proof is accepted and at least one category is claimed.
matrix_incomplete: The score is incomplete until the senior-high average, the admission-test points, and the financial points are all recorded.
matrix_gwa_required: An incoming first-year student needs a senior-high average before the application can be accepted or made conditional.
matrix_below_80: An incoming first-year student with a senior-high average below 80% cannot be accepted or made conditional.
matrix_below_program_floor: This program requires a higher senior-high average than the one recorded.
matrix_gwa_invalid: The senior-high average cannot be above 100.
tpccat_help: Enter the points that count toward 35. The manual does not publish a raw-score conversion.
financial_help: Enter the points that count toward 30. The manual does not publish a point rubric.
tarlac_resident_help: Used only when two complete scores are equal.
sector_verified: Proof of the claimed category was accepted
sector_underserved_area: From an unserved or underserved area
sector_solo_parent: Solo parent, or child of a solo parent
sector_pwd: Person with disability, or child or parent of one
sector_displaced_or_pdl: Displaced or conflict-affected family, former PDL, or parent or guardian is a PDL
minimum_gwa_help: Leave blank unless this program requires an average above 80%. The 80% floor still applies to incoming first-year students.
midterm_on_help: A course dropped on or after this date is recorded as 5.00. Leave blank until the office sets the date.
